title: DocumentSendRequest
description: Request body for sending a document to its recipients for signature.

subject.description: Email subject line sent to recipients.

message.description: Body text of the email sent to recipients.
message.example: Hi, please review and sign the attached agreement at your earliest convenience.

silent.description: If true, suppresses email notification to recipients. The document is marked as sent but recipients are not emailed.

sender.description: Override sender details for the notification email.
